sloka: चरणेनापि सव्येन न स्पृशेयं निशाचरम् ।रावणं किं पुनरहं कामयेयं विगर्हितम् ।। ५.२४.९।।।।
transliteration: caraṇenāpi savyena na spṛśeyaṁ niśācaram ।rāvaṇaṁ kiṁ punarahaṁ kāmayeyaṁ vigarhitam ।। 5.24.9।।।।

translations.english: 'Dejected or dethroned from the kingdom, Rama is my lawful husband. I will ever remain devoted to Rama as Suvarchala, wife of the Sungod is to him.
